name: Droppy
soft_passes: #1 respects mask outline but bakes an inner-frame bevel + drop-shadow the system should apply
#4 survives 16px as a clean blue tile with no smear, but the notch vanishes and identity does not survive
#5 emissive-screen light model is coherent, but the frame bevel adds a mild second top-down cue
#9 commits to 'lit screen in dark device' yet mixes Big-Sur baked-bevel depth with Liquid-Glass specular
failures: #3 silhouette collapses to a featureless squircle when filled black; meaning lives in blue-on-black tone, not shape
#10 single baked raster with baked bevel/rim/specular, no Default/Dark/Clear/Tinted layer story; black frame is dark-mode-fragile

palette.background: black device bezel #010101->#070707 (bevel highlight to #3E3E3E); screen ramp #08376E->#3C99E9

light_model: Emissive backlit screen: cyan inner-rim glow brightest at the screen edges (#ABD6F7) with an hourglass/pinched specular bloom - bright lobes upper (#5EAAE7) and lower (#4084C0) meeting a dark navy waist at centre (#08376E); plus a milder top-down bevel highlight on the black frame. Reads as a lit glass display inside a dark device.
layer_stack: black device bezel/frame filling the squircle (baked bevel + inner shadow)
notched inner-screen recess (MacBook notch cut into top edge, centred)
devices: notch-as-subject (literal MacBook notch cut into the top of the screen)
backlit glass screen (rim-light + hourglass specular making a flat field read as an emissive display)
rhymes_hint: device-portrait notch/menu-bar utility icons that depict the Mac hardware itself (NotchNook / Boring-Notch black-panel family) and glossy blue-gradient rim-lit-screen utility tiles; provisional style-family 'glossy blue-gradient device-frame utility'
notes: icon.png is native 1024x1024 with transparent squircle corners (not a web resize) - full-res, measurements are clean. PIL flags indexed-palette+alpha but resolution is genuine. Icon bakes bevel/drop-shadow/specular/rim-glow that current HIG says the system should apply (Big-Sur-era authoring habit); it is a single raster, not Icon Composer layers, so it has no dark/clear/tinted variant path and the black bezel dissolves against a dark Dock/wallpaper. Strong subject-mining (concept = notch productivity hub, icon = the notch) is the standout, undercut by a non-existent silhouette. First device-portrait and first notch-as-subject icon in the corpus - do not promote, single app. Icon<->cover coherence is motif-based (notch / black rounded panel) not hue-based (icon saturated blue vs cover neutral-black-over-photo).
